en: A black and white image depicting a quiet European street lined with detached houses featuring steeply pitched roofs, shuttered windows, and simple facades. There are a number of people walking along the sidewalk and road, wearing turn-of-the-century clothing. The street appears to ascend toward wooded hills in the background, and the buildings are adorned with some climbing plants. The scene is tranquil, with no cars visible, giving it an early 20th century or late 19th century ambiance.
